items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: La Roca was the name of them boys. I don't know if it's Tony La Roca or what. I was the one. Them boys used to play back there and make records

ctx.x: When you had, when you played with the band with your violin, Mr. Robinson, were you the leader of the band? I was. You were always a leader. I was. You used to do Stump Off? Yeah, yeah. I see.

I was the one. Yeah, La Roca was the name of them boys. I don't know if it's Tony La Roca or what. I was the one. Them boys used to play back there and make records, you know. The rock. I didn't know this was coming on. If I knew that. Yeah, I know. Keep all them things, you know. Keep all them things. But now I don't know what the devil I could find. I might got them stick up somewhere. You know. Got them in this little jammer place there. I had to hunt about two weeks to fight. Yeah. Yeah. If I wanted, I had to…
Yeah. Fine. Yeah. Can you tell us, do you remember any of the old time violin players? Anybody else that played violin when you were young? Yeah, no fella. In the city here?
